name: Mawsynram Presbyterian Church
town_description: Mawsynram, in Meghalaya's East Khasi Hills about 60 km southwest of Shillong, is famed as one of the wettest inhabited places on Earth, receiving over 11,000 mm of annual rainfall. Attractions include the Mawjymbuin Cave with its natural Shiva lingam and the surrounding rain-soaked hills and waterfalls.
